page_title: EVE 0-0 AST | Everton v Aston Villa 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+7' Amadou Onana (Everton) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
90+7' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
90+6' David Coote blows his whistle as Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90+5' Jack Harrison (Everton) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90+4' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' That will be all from John McGinn who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa).
89' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
88' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) does well to meet a cross from Matty Cash, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post.

87' John McGinn (Aston Villa) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
86' A pass lands at the feet of Matty Cash (Aston Villa) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
83' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.

80' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
80' A cross is whipped into the box by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) and Ollie Watkins controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
79' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
78' James Tarkowski (Everton) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
77' An attempted cross from Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) is cleared.
75' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) has tested the patience of referee David Coote and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
74' A substitution has been made. Diego Carlos goes off and Matty Cash (Aston Villa) comes on.
73' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by James Tarkowski (Everton) was quite harsh and David Coote didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
64' Moussa Diaby will be replaced by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa).
64' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Leon Bailey will be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
63' Here is a change. Arnaut Danjuma is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Dwight McNeil (Everton).
63' Here's the change. Dominic Calvert-Lewin leaves the pitch and Beto (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
62' Jordan Pickford makes a brilliant save! Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
62' A lofted cross from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
62' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
62' The ball is cleared after Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
61' John McGinn (Aston Villa) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
60' The attendance for today's match is 39284.
59' Seamus Coleman (Everton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
59' A cross into the box from Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is cleared.
58' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes it short.

58' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
57' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a long ball in, but Emiliano Martinez comfortably gathers the ball.
56' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
54' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
54' Jack Harrison (Everton) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
53' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) picks up an injury.
48' A yellow card is awarded to Diego Carlos (Aston Villa).
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Jordan Pickford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
45+4' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
45+3' Seamus Coleman (Everton) tackles a bit over-zealously and David Coote blows for a foul. Aston Villa will take a free kick near the side line.
45+3' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
45+2' The resulting corner from Jack Harrison (Everton) is cleared by the defence.
45+1' Jack Harrison (Everton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
45' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
43' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
40' A clumsy foul by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) and David Coote blows his whistle. Everton earn a free kick.
36' The corner from James Garner (Everton) is hurriedly cleared.

36' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Everton.
35' The percentage of ball possession is – 29:71.
34' James Tarkowski (Everton) is able to continue to play.
31' The game is interrupted now, James Tarkowski (Everton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
30' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) takes a pot shot from distance after a rebound fell kindly for him, but it's blocked by an opponent.
29' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Aston Villa.
29' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

28' A pass into the box finds Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jordan Pickford denies him. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
28' Wonderful movement by Aston Villa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
27' John McGinn (Aston Villa) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
24' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
24' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Aston Villa earn a corner.
22' Celebrations are cut short for Aston Villa as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
20' Wait! Referee David Coote has indicated he is going to review the Aston Villa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
18' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
18' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) works the corner short.

18' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
13' What a sweet touch by Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) as he collects a pass deep inside the box and decides to go for goal. It's on target but easy for Jordan Pickford to hold.
11' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
10' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from James Garner (Everton) on the edge of the box.

9' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Everton earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
6' Amadou Onana (Everton) commits a foul and David Coote immediately signals a free kick.

6' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
6' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
4' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends the corner into the box, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts it and averts the threat.
3' Jack Harrison (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Everton will take a corner kick.
3' One of the players from Everton times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
2' The game is interrupted. Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
